description:
What kind of homes an area is made of: separate houses, semi-detached and townhouses, flats by height of block, and other dwellings, plus how many homes stood empty, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 11,500 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/dwelling-structure`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_occupied_dwellings, separate_house_count, separate_house_pct, semi_detached_count, semi_detached_pct, semi_detached_one_storey_count, semi_detached_one_storey_pct, semi_detached_two_plus_storeys_count, semi_detached_two_plus_storeys_pct, flat_or_apartment_count, flat_or_apartment_pct, flat_one_or_two_storey_block_count, flat_one_or_two_storey_block_pct, flat_three_storey_block_count, flat_three_storey_block_pct, flat_four_to_eight_storey_block_count, flat_four_to_eight_storey_block_pct, flat_nine_plus_storey_block_count, flat_nine_plus_storey_block_pct, flat_attached_to_house_count, flat_attached_to_house_pct, other_dwelling_count, other_dwelling_pct, caravan_count, caravan_pct, cabin_or_houseboat_count, cabin_or_houseboat_pct, improvised_home_or_tent_count, improvised_home_or_tent_pct, attached_to_shop_or_office_count, attached_to_shop_or_office_pct, structure_not_stated_count, structure_not_stated_pct, total_private_dwellings, unoccupied_count, unoccupied_pct. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
